## Summary

One sentence describing the finding.

## Severity

Pick exactly one:

- [ ] blocker — core loop integrity broken or build cannot continue
- [ ] major — wrong, misleading, or unrecoverable behavior; trust damaged
- [ ] minor — noticeable issue with limited downstream impact
- [ ] polish — friction or copy issue with no functional impact
- [ ] insight — design observation, not a defect

See [docs/playtest-prompts.md](../../docs/playtest-prompts.md) for definitions.
